# Step - to_v

`to_v` · `toV` · category: [Walking the graph](../../traversal/step_reference.md#walking-the-graph)

Moves from an edge to its vertex in the given Direction (Direction.OUT: out vertex).

## Forms

```text
to_v(arg1: Direction)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.e("0").to_v(Direction.IN).values("name").next()   // vadas
```
